offering_description.value: Supplies drinking water to households, businesses and municipalities through treatment plants and piped distribution networks. It also provides wastewater collection and treatment and operates utility systems under contract.

primary_services.value: water treatment and distribution; wastewater collection and treatment; contract utility operations and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2C: households connected to local water and sewer systems; B2B: commercial and industrial facilities, private institutions and water utilities; B2G: municipalities and public agencies buying bulk water or contracting for utility operations

end_markets.value: residential utilities; commercial and institutional facilities; industrial facilities; municipal utilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: metered retail and wholesale water deliveries; service fees: recurring water and sewer charges under regulated tariffs; project or contract: operation and maintenance of utility systems for municipalities and other system owners
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: treats source water for retail and wholesale customers and handles sewage from connected properties; service provider: operates and maintains utility infrastructure for municipalities and other system owners

geography_served.value: US regional: New Jersey and Delaware

specialization.value: related lines: drinking water supply, wastewater services and contracted utility operations

distribution_channels.value: other: local water mains and sewer networks connecting directly to customer properties; direct sales: bulk water agreements and utility operating contracts with municipalities and other system owners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Utility rates and service oversight by the New Jersey BPU and Delaware PSC, plus drinking water and wastewater standards.

notes: The current scope of individual utility operating contracts is uncertain.
